steps.title: Projection
steps.body: Projection opens a palette that changes how the Sun is mapped onto the screen. Orthographic draws it in 3D; HPC, Helioradial and Helioradial Unrolled are flat maps of the sky around it; Latitudinal is a map of the surface.

steps.title: Warp
steps.body: In the Helioradial projections, Warp is the strength of the Box-Cox stretch (lambda): to the right it stretches the inner corona outward, at the left it is the unwarped view.

steps.title: Crop
steps.body: Crop cuts the picture to a disc, in solar radii, and frames that disc without changing the warp. Leftmost is automatic: no crop.

steps.title: Back to the defaults
steps.body: Reset view returns warp, crop and zoom to their defaults.

steps.title: Camera
steps.body: Camera sets where the view is seen from: Free, from the active image layer's observer; Follow, from a selected object; or Overview, down on the solar equatorial plane. It can also revolve the camera about an axis.

steps.title: Track solar rotation
steps.body: Track keeps the view turning with the Sun as the movie plays; Differential, beside it, toggles differential rotation.

steps.title: Multiview
steps.body: Multiview puts each shown image layer in a view of its own, side by side.

steps.title: Compare
steps.body: Compare blinks between two image layers, or swipes a divider across the view with one on each side. Layers > Duplicate Layer gives you a copy of a layer to compare against.

steps.title: Pizza
steps.body: Pizza cuts every shown image layer into its own wedges or tiles of one Sun. The wedges follow solar north, so they stay on the Sun as the camera moves; in Helioradial Unrolled they become strips.

steps.title: Grid and overlays
steps.body: Grid holds the coordinate grid, the solar limb, the Thomson and celestial spheres, the ecliptic plane and the planets, each with its own colour, opacity and width.

steps.title: Reset View
steps.body: Reset View returns the view to its default; double-clicking the canvas does the same.
